name: Győrasszonyfa (Hungary)
description: White field charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Győrasszonyfa (a crowned yellow shield with a red, white and green charge and the year 1150) above the words GYŐRASSZONYFA KÖZSÉG in black.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
